verdict.rationale: Claude Code ships an Agent SDK giving programmatic 'full control over orchestration, tool access, and permissions' using the same underlying tools as the CLI/UI, plus API-key auth and a `claude mcp serve` mode exposing Claude Code itself as an MCP server for other apps to drive — all pointing toward API-level parity with interactive use. However, the evidence never explicitly enumerates which UI-only surfaces (web dashboard, Slack routing, Remote Control, teleport, GitHub Code Review) are fully reachable via the SDK/API versus only via the hosted UI integrations, so full parity isn't documented. Missing for 10: explicit confirmation that web/Slack/Remote-Control/scheduling features are all API-accessible, and independent corroboration of SDK feature parity.
